services.title: Individual Income Tax
services.summary: Personal returns prepared and filed.
services.text: Personal tax returns prepared accurately and on time, whether you are a W-2 employee, self-employed or a small business owner, with deductions and credits reviewed so your liability is no higher than it has to be.
services.lead: Tax season can be a stressful time. We prepare individual returns, take the time to understand your specific financial situation, and work to maximize your deductions and credits while minimizing your tax liability.
services.imageAlt: Tax forms and a pen on a desk

covers.title: Return preparation
covers.text: Federal returns prepared accurately and filed on time, whether your situation is simple or complex.

covers.title: Deductions and credits
covers.text: A review of the deductions and credits available to you, so your liability is no higher than it needs to be.

covers.title: Current with the law
covers.text: Our team stays up to date on the latest tax law changes and regulations.

covers.title: Everything in one place
covers.text: Tax planning, bookkeeping, financial consulting and IRS representation sit alongside preparation, so your needs are met under one roof.

services.title: IRS Audit Representation
services.summary: Representation when the IRS audits you.
services.text: We represent individuals and businesses through an IRS audit, gathering the documentation, dealing with the IRS on your behalf and negotiating a resolution.
services.lead: Facing an IRS audit can be stressful. When the IRS audits you it will review your financial records and tax returns to check that everything is accurate and in compliance with tax law. We take that work off your hands.

covers.title: Documentation
covers.text: We gather all the documentation the audit calls for so nothing is missing when the IRS asks.

covers.title: Dealing with the IRS
covers.text: We communicate with the IRS on your behalf and negotiate a fair resolution to the audit findings.

covers.title: Penalties
covers.text: We use our knowledge of tax law to minimize any penalties or fines that may be imposed.

services.title: ITIN Applications
services.summary: ITIN applications for those without an SSN.
services.text: Individual Taxpayer Identification Number services for people who are not eligible for a Social Security Number, handled by an IRS Certifying Acceptance Agent.
services.lead: The ITIN is a tax processing number issued by the IRS so that people who cannot obtain a Social Security Number, including some nonresident aliens, can still file taxes in the United States.

covers.title: The application
covers.text: Applicants must submit a federal income tax return with certain required documentation. We make sure the forms and documents are completed accurately and submitted to the IRS.

covers.title: Certifying Acceptance Agent
covers.text: As an IRS Certifying Acceptance Agent, we can help with your ITIN application whether you are a non-resident alien or a foreign national living in the United States.

services.title: Filing a Tax Extension
services.summary: Form 4868 when you need more time.
services.text: If you need more time to file, we handle the extension and explain what it does and does not change about what you owe.
services.lead: To request a tax extension you typically file Form 4868 with the IRS, which extends your filing deadline by six months, to October 15th instead of the usual April 15th deadline.

covers.title: What an extension does not do
covers.text: An extension grants more time to file, but not more time to pay. Any tax due must still be paid by the original deadline to avoid penalties and interest.

covers.title: Getting it right
covers.text: We help you understand these nuances and make sure you meet all the requirements for an extension.

services.title: FBAR Reporting
services.summary: Foreign bank account reporting.
services.text: FBAR is a mandatory annual report for anyone with foreign financial accounts exceeding $10,000 at any time during the year. We assess, file and keep you compliant.
services.lead: FBAR stands for Foreign Bank and Financial Account Report. It is a mandatory annual report for U.S. citizens, residents and entities, including corporations, partnerships and trusts, that have financial interests in or signature authority over foreign financial accounts exceeding $10,000 at any time during the calendar year.

covers.title: Consultation and assessment
covers.text: A detailed assessment of your financial situation to determine your FBAR obligations, identifying all foreign accounts and their balances through the year.

covers.title: Filing assistance
covers.text: Preparing and filing your FBAR electronically through FinCEN's BSA E-Filing System.

covers.title: Compliance strategy
covers.text: Strategies to stay compliant year after year rather than scrambling each time.

covers.title: Audit support
covers.text: Support and representation if your foreign account reporting is examined.

questions.q: What happens if I do not file an FBAR?
questions.a: Non-willful violations can incur fines up to $10,000 per violation, and willful violations can attract steeper penalties, including criminal charges and fines up to $100,000 or 50% of the account balance.

covers.title: What happens next

about.title: A Richardson CPA firm led by its founder.
text: Rahman CPA Tax & Accounting PLLC is a CPA firm in Richardson, Texas. Anisur Rahman is the managing principal and founder, and holds a CPA license in both Texas and Connecticut.

Over more than 10 years in the accounting industry, he has worked with a diverse range of clients, including healthcare organizations, nonprofits, government agencies, small businesses and big4 firms. That exposure to different sectors means each client's work is tailored to the challenges their own industry brings.
The firm covers auditing, tax preparation, financial consulting and more, so clients can get their accounting needs met in one place rather than across several providers.

faqs.q: Do you work with individuals as well as businesses?
faqs.a: Yes. Whether you are an individual taxpayer or a small business owner, we have the expertise to meet your tax and accounting needs.

faqs.q: Can you represent me if the IRS audits me?
faqs.a: Yes. We gather the documentation, communicate with the IRS on your behalf and negotiate a resolution to the audit findings.

faqs.q: Can you help me get an ITIN?
faqs.a: Yes. We are an IRS Certifying Acceptance Agent and can help with the ITIN application process, whether you are a non-resident alien or a foreign national living in the United States.
